title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Severely Cracking Down on Criminal Activities Disrupting Flood Relief
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Severely Cracking Down on Criminal Activities That Undermine Flood Relief and Disaster Relief

Fa (Yan) Fa [1991] No. 20

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army:

1. Since May of this year, severe floods and other natural disasters have occurred in some areas of our country, causing heavy losses to local industrial and agricultural production and to the lives and property of the people. In the struggle in which the people of the whole country, together with the people in the disaster areas, have been supporting disaster relief and rescue efforts in various forms and organizing production self-help, the people's courts shall fully exercise their adjudicative functions, and by law severely crack down on all criminal activities that undermine flood relief and disaster relief and undermine production and living order in the disaster areas, so as to ensure good social order in the affected areas.

2. The people's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the law, promptly and severely crack down on all kinds of criminal activities that undermine flood relief and disaster relief. With respect to those who, for counter-revolutionary purposes, spread rumors to confuse the public and engage in various destructive activities that constitute a crime, they shall be convicted and sentenced in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law concerning counter-revolutionary crimes; with respect to serious criminal activities such as robbery of flood control equipment and disaster relief funds and materials, robbery of public and private property in disaster areas, rape of women, as well as criminal activities of theft and sabotage of transportation, electric power, and communication facilities, they shall be resolutely and severely sentenced in accordance with the law, swiftly; with respect to embezzlement, theft, and misappropriation of disaster relief funds, materials, and donations, they shall be promptly and severely sentenced in accordance with the law. Higher people's courts shall strengthen supervision and guidance over the trial of the above-mentioned criminal cases.

3. With respect to the above-mentioned criminal cases, after acceptance, the people's courts shall organize sufficient judicial forces to promptly and publicly try and publicly sentence them in accordance with the law; where conditions permit, public sentencing shall also be conducted at the place where the crime occurred. Care shall be taken to select appropriate typical cases and to publicly report them through newspapers, radio, and television, so as to deter crime, encourage and educate the masses to wage a resolute struggle against illegal and criminal acts that undermine disaster relief and rescue, and to win victory in the struggle against disasters and for relief.

4. While severely cracking down on criminal activities that undermine flood relief and disaster relief, the people's courts shall, in accordance with the provisions of laws and relevant policies, promptly accept and handle in accordance with the law all kinds of civil, economic disputes and administrative cases arising from floods and disaster relief and rescue, so as to facilitate unity in disaster resistance and relief. During the litigation process, care shall be taken to prevent the expansion of incidents and the intensification of conflicts.

July 26, 1991
